Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/hooks/use-video-engine.ts:
     1	"use client"
     2	
     3	import { createDecartClient, models } from "@decartai/sdk"
     4	import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react"
     5	
     6	export type VideoConnectionState =
     7	  | "idle"
     8	  | "connecting"
     9	  | "connected"
    10	  | "generating"
    11	  | "reconnecting"
    12	  | "disconnected"
    13	
    14	type RealtimeClient = Awaited<
    15	  ReturnType<ReturnType<typeof createDecartClient>["realtime"]["connect"]>
    16	>
    17	
    18	export function useVideoEngine() {
    19	  const [state, setState] = useState<VideoConnectionState>("idle")
    20	  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null)
    21	
    22	  const localStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
    23	  const clientRef = useRef<RealtimeClient | null>(null)
    24	  const localVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null)
    25	  const remoteVideoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement | null>(null)
    26	
    27	  const start = useCallback(
    28	    async (opts: { prompt?: string; image?: Blob | string | null }) => {
    29	      setError(null)
    30	      setState("connecting")
    31	      try {
    32	        // 1. Mint a short-lived client token from our server.
    33	        const tokenRes = await fetch("/api/realtime-token", { method: "POST" })
    34	        if (!tokenRes.ok) throw new Error("Could not get a realtime token.")
    35	        const { apiKey } = await tokenRes.json()
    36	        if (!apiKey) throw new Error("Realtime token missing from response.")
    37	
    38	        // 2. Get the camera + mic stream at the model's preferred resolution.
    39	        const model = models.realtime("lucy-2.1")
    40	        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    41	          audio: true,
    42	          video: {
    43	            frameRate: model.fps,
    44	            width: model.width,
    45	            height: model.height,
    46	            facingMode: "user",
    47	          },
    48	        })
    49	        let stream: MediaStream
    50	        try {
    51	          stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
    52	            audio: true,
    53	            video: {
    54	              frameRate: model.fps,
    55	              width: model.width,
    56	              height: model.height,
    57	              facingMode: "user",
    58	            },
    59	          })
    60	        } catch (mediaErr) {
    61	          throw new Error(describeMediaError(mediaErr))
    62	        }
    63	        localStreamRef.current = stream
    64	        if (localVideoRef.current) {
    65	          localVideoRef.current.srcObject = stream
    66	        }
    67	
    68	        // 3. Connect to Decart's realtime engine over WebRTC.
    69	        const client = createDecartClient({ apiKey })
    70	        const realtimeClient = await client.realtime.connect(stream, {
    71	          model,
    72	          mirror: "auto",
    73	          onRemoteStream: (transformedStream: MediaStream) => {
    74	            if (remoteVideoRef.current) {
    75	              remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = transformedStream
    76	            }
    77	          },
    78	          initialState: {
    79	            prompt: opts.prompt
    80	              ? { text: opts.prompt, enhance: true }
    81	              : undefined,
    82	            image: opts.image ?? undefined,
    83	          },
    84	        })
    85	
    86	        clientRef.current = realtimeClient
    87	
    88	        realtimeClient.on("connectionChange", (s: VideoConnectionState) => {
    89	          setState(s)
    90	        })
    91	        realtimeClient.on("error", (e: { code?: string; message: string }) => {
    92	          console.error("[v0] Decart error:", e.code, e.message)
    93	          setError(e.message)
    94	        })
    95	
    96	        setState(realtimeClient.isConnected() ? "connected" : "connecting")
    97	      } catch (e) {
    98	        const message = e instanceof Error ? e.message : "Failed to start video."
    99	        console.error("[v0] start video failed:", message)
   100	        setError(message)
   101	        setState("idle")
   102	        localStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop())
   103	        localStreamRef.current = null
   104	      }
   105	    },
   106	    [],
   107	  )
   108	
   109	  // Atomically replace the transformation state (prompt and/or reference image).
   110	  const update = useCallback(
   111	    async (next: { prompt?: string; image?: Blob | string | null }) => {
   112	      const client = clientRef.current
   113	      if (!client) return
   114	      try {
   115	        await client.set({
   116	          prompt: next.prompt,
   117	          image: next.image ?? undefined,
   118	          enhance: true,
   119	        })
   120	      } catch (e) {
   121	        console.error("[v0] update transform failed:", e)
   122	      }
   123	    },
   124	    [],
   125	  )
   126	
   127	  const stop = useCallback(() => {
   128	    clientRef.current?.disconnect()
   129	    clientRef.current = null
   130	    localStreamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop())
   131	    localStreamRef.current = null
   132	    if (localVideoRef.current) localVideoRef.current.srcObject = null
   133	    if (remoteVideoRef.current) remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = null
   134	    setState("idle")
   135	  }, [])
   136	
   137	  return {
   138	    state,
   139	    error,
   140	    isActive: state !== "idle" && state !== "disconnected",
   141	    localVideoRef,
   142	    remoteVideoRef,
   143	    start,
   144	    update,
   145	    stop,
   146	  }
   147	}
   148
